title: Movie ticket booking design
idea: A ticket booking design models movies, theatres, screens, shows and seats, and lets a user hold seats briefly so only one person can pay for each.

analogy.text: A busy restaurant host pencils your name against a table for ten minutes. Arrive late and the table goes to the next group.
analogy.breaks: A host may bend the rule; the code never does.

points: `Theatre` has `Screen`s; a `Show` is one `Movie` on one screen at one time.
Each show seat moves FREE, then HELD with an expiry, then BOOKED.
Hold and confirm run under one lock, so two users never hold one seat.
The caller passes the clock in, so expiry is testable and repeatable.

hero.title: Two users, one seat, one winner

messages.label: hold A1 at 0
messages.note: ana picks A1. It is FREE, so it becomes HELD until minute 10.

messages.label: true
messages.note: ana has the hold and goes to pay.

messages.label: hold A1 at 5
messages.note: ben wants the same seat. The hold is live, so he is refused.

messages.label: pay
messages.note: ana's payment stalls. Her hold expires at minute 10 while she waits.

messages.label: hold A1 at 12
messages.note: ben retries after the expiry. The stale hold clears and ben holds A1.

messages.label: pay
messages.note: ben pays inside his ten-minute window.

messages.label: confirm A1 at 13
messages.note: ana's late confirm is refused: she no longer holds the seat. Refund her.

messages.label: confirm A1 at 13
messages.note: Only the live holder may confirm. A1 becomes BOOKED for ben.

code.title: Hold, expire, confirm
code.caption: `ShowSeats` is the seat map of one `Show`. The story from the diagram, with the clock passed in as minutes.

walk.text: An `enum` for seat states; each seat remembers its holder and expiry.
An expired hold is cleared when someone next asks for the seat.
Only a FREE seat can be held; the hold lasts `holdMinutes`.
Confirm only for the current holder, and only before the expiry.
`synchronized` makes the check and the change one step per show.
`main` replays ana and ben at minutes 0, 5, 12 and 13.

code.title: Eight users race
code.caption: Eight threads try to hold the same two seats at once. Only counts are printed.

walk.text: Eight tasks each ask for seats C4 and C5 together.
Wait for every task to finish before reading the results.
All or nothing: check every seat, then take them all, under one lock.
Print counts only; which user wins changes from run to run.

pitfalls: Never check-then-take without a lock; two users both see FREE and both book.
Give every hold an expiry, or abandoned checkouts block seats forever.
Confirm only for the live holder before expiry, and refund late payments.

quiz.why: `holdAll` is `synchronized`, so check and take happen as one step. The first thread takes both seats; the other seven see them held.

takeaway: Hold seats briefly under a lock; confirm only as the live holder.

starters: How would this work with a database instead of one lock in memory?
Should each show have its own lock, or one for the whole system?
How do I release holds when nobody asks for the seat again?
